$comment: Named camera states for the Lumen One. Shared by scene.ts (real time) and scripts/halvane/build_speaker.py (Cycles posters and stills), so a still and the live canvas frame the speaker identically. three.js axes, metres: y up, the speaker's front faces +z, its feet stand on y = 0. yaw: the speaker's turn about y in degrees (a turntable under fixed lights). fov: field of view across the viewport's SHORT side, in degrees. shift: where the target lands, from the viewport centre, in short-side units (x right, y up). portrait: overrides for viewports taller than wide. explode: drivers forward (0-1), or per driver ({"Woofer": 1} moves only the woofer). hatch: the back plate opened to show the crossover (0-1). poster (optional): cover = how much wider than the state's fov the Cycles poster is rendered, for close-ups that must fill the screen (the page scales and masks it to match). lamp (optional): a soft disc light added for this state only, aimed at the target: pos (three.js metres), power (W in Cycles; scene.ts maps it to its own intensity), size (diameter, m), k (colour temperature).
